# Unbalanced

#### Course: DSA with C++

## Unbalanced

Finally, we have an unbalanced state where there is considerable difference between the heights and/or depths of the left and right subtree of a node.

![Unbalanced Tree](data:image/png;base64,)

Binary search trees in this state suffer from various levels of performance loss, depending on the degree of imbalance.
